summary: Use these compatibility pages when the hotel project already knows the lock or encoder estate and needs a faster path to the right card material, chip family and sample plan.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
Start with the installed lock or encoder environment, not the card finish.

faq.question: Do compatibility pages guarantee card support?
faq.answer: No. They organize the first compatibility checks so the sample round starts from the most realistic card paths instead of broad catalog browsing.

faq.question: What speeds up a compatibility reply most?
faq.answer: A current guest card sample, a lock or encoder reference and a clear note on whether the property needs plain stock, branded cards or pre-encoding.
